title: B-21 Field Training Detachment Facility, Dyess AFB-OT Feasibility & Business Feedback
description: SUBJECT: Sources Sought Notice/RFI �B-21 Field Training Detachment Facility, Dyess AFB DISCLAIMER: This Sources Sought (SS) is for planning and market research purposes only and does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP) or an Invitation for Bids (IFB). This notice is issued under the authority of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a (Other Transaction Authority for Construction and Repair) and is not subject to the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). No solicitation is available at this time. The Government will not pay for any information submitted in response to this notice. PURPOSE: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Fort Worth District, is conducting active public market intelligence to gauge industry interest, capacity, and capability from commercial construction firms, design-builders, and Non-Traditional Defense Contractors (NDCs). The intent is to gather critical feedback regarding advanced commercial construction methodologies, project delivery risks, and acquisition preferences to support our upcoming project delivery selection. PROJECT DESCRIPTION This project will construct a two-story, approximately 55,617 gross square foot Field Training Detachment facility for B-21 maintenance training at Dyess Air Force Base, Texas, with an estimated Construction Cost Limitation (CCL) of $66,200,000. The facility will feature a steel-frame structure with a metal roof, concrete masonry unit exterior walls, and a drilled concrete pier foundation system designed for local expansive soil conditions. Functional requirements include high bay trainers and classrooms for B-21 maintenance, substantial secure space constructed in compliance with Intelligence Community Directive (ICD) 705 standards with construction security surveillance, a 440-ton HVAC capacity, ducted communications, utilities, and associated site infrastructure and paving. Description of Requirement The Air Force Services Center (AFSVC) has an upcoming requirement for professional independent auditing services to evaluate, analyze, and report on the financial status and operational compliance of various Nonappropriated Fund Instrumentalities (NAFIs). The contractor will perform Public Accountant Contract Audits (PACA) in accordance with Government Auditing Standards (GAGAS) and Air Force instructions. The primary objectives are to ensure financial integrity, statutory compliance, and operational efficiency across critical morale, welfare, and recreation (MWR) activities supporting Airmen, Guardians, and their families globally. The program areas of focus include, but are not limited to: AFSVC Shared Service Center (SSC): Comprehensive financial statement and compliance auditing. Air Force Venture Gaming Program: Financial and operational auditing of gaming systems, to include potential overseas locations. Air Force Cadet Dining: Specialized operational and financial compliance audits. Commander's Special Interest Audits: Targeted, ad-hoc audits ordered at the discretion of leadership. 4. Locations of Performance See separate attachment 'Installation Listing - Special Audits.xls'. 5. Contract Structure and Anticipated Period of Performance The NAFI intends to award a contract consisting of a one-year Base Period and four (4) one-year Option Periods. Initial task orders are anticipated to utilize a hybrid of contract types to align performance incentives: CLIN SeriesService TypeContract Pricing TypeCLIN 0001 seriesAnnual NAFI Financial Statement AuditsFirm-Fixed-Price (FFP)CLIN 0002 seriesProgram-Specific Performance AuditsFirm-Fixed-Price (FFP)CLIN 0003 seriesCommander's Special Interest Audits (Ad-hoc)Time & Materials (T&M) or Labor-HourCLIN 0004 seriesReimbursable Travel ExpensesCost-Reimbursable (No Fee) 6. Special Procurement Considerations Pre-Proposal Conference: A virtual pre-proposal conference is tentatively planned to take place in CY2026 Q4 to discuss the unique aspects of military NAF accounting and AFSVC systems. Questions and Clarifications: Offerors will be given a designated period to submit formal Requests for Information (RFIs) regarding system access, data repositories, and historical workload data. II. INDUSTRY FEEDBACK AND CAPABILITY QUESTIONS To help the Air Force Services Center refine its solicitation and evaluate industry capability, interested vendors are requested to respond to the following questions: 1. Corporate Capability & Special Audit Execution Question 1a: Describe your firm's experience in performing financial statement audits for Government Nonappropriated Fund Instrumentalities (NAFIs) or similar dual-funded public entities. Question 1b: What experience does your firm have in executing audits under Government Auditing Standards (GAGAS) (Yellow Book), particularly regarding the integration of financial and compliance audits? Question 1c: Given the potential requirement for "Commander's Special Interest Audits," describe your capacity to mobilize audit teams on short notice (e.g., within 15�30 days) to address ad-hoc, high-priority inquiries. 2. Geographically Dispersed & Virtual Auditing Question 2a: Describe your proposed approach to executing comprehensive audits remotely while maintaining secure data controls. How does your firm minimize the need for on-site physical presence while ensuring complete verification of records? Question 2b: The Air Force Venture Gaming Program operates at several overseas locations. Describe your firm�s capability to conduct international audit procedures, including any potential travel logistics or remote verification methodologies for overseas operations. 3. Technology Systems & Secure Data Repositories Question 3a: The contractor will be required to utilize a secure, DoD-compliant file repository to transmit, store, and review sensitive financial data. Describe your firm�s experience in utilizing government-provided secure portals (e.g., DoD SAFE, secure SharePoint) or hosting NIST SP 800-171 compliant environments. Question 3b: AFSVC utilizes specific Point-of-Sale (POS) and shared services database systems. What experience does your audit team have in extracting, normalizing, and auditing large transaction-level datasets directly from enterprise-level ERP or POS systems without manual entry errors? 4. Contract Structure, Workload, & Risk Question 4a: Initial task orders may require dual-year financial audits (e.g., covering both FY24 and FY25 concurrently). Does your firm foresee any resource or independence constraints with executing dual-year audits under a single task order? Question 4b: Travel costs are excluded from the firm-fixed-price labor rates and will be reimbursed separately at actual cost (subject to Joint Travel Regulations). Do you find this structure clear and commercially feasible? Question 4c: What additional historical workload metrics or system information (e.g., transactional volume, prior year audit reports) would your firm require to provide an accurate, competitive firm-fixed-price proposal?

title: Shipboard Air Conditioning Plant System Sustainment Plan (SSP)
description: 1.0 PURPOSE AND BACKGROUND PAE Maritime is conducting market research to identify responsible sources capable of providing some or all the sustainment capabilities required to support U.S. Navy surface-ship centrifugal, reciprocating, and rotary air conditioning (AC) plants worldwide. The information received will help the Government assess available industry capabilities and determine an appropriate acquisition strategy, contract structure, and number of sources. The Navy�s AC Plant System Sustainment Plan (SSP) establishes a standardized, scalable approach intended to improve materiel condition and operational availability across multiple AC plant configurations, ship classes, and geographically dispersed maintenance activities. The contemplated scope includes maintenance, technical expertise, materiel, rotable inventory management, engineering, logistics, training, and emergent field services. The Government is considering a range of acquisition approaches, which may include a single-award Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract, multiple contracts, or coordinated capabilities from multiple sources. No final acquisition strategy has been selected. Respondents may describe capabilities they can provide individually, through existing or proposed teaming arrangements, or as part of a broader sustainment solution. 2.0 CONTEMPLATED SUSTAINMENT CAPABILITIES The Government is seeking information on the capabilities summarized below and detailed in the Capability Certification Matrix (Table 1). Respondents may address any one or more capability areas. For each area addressed, identify current capabilities, how the work would be performed, and any relevant limitations, dependencies, or capability-development needs. 2.1 Major AC Plant Pit Stops Major Pit Stops include comprehensive plant assessment, troubleshooting, corrective maintenance, component repair or replacement, in-place compressor overhaul, testing, and restoration of the plant to operational condition. Major Pit Stops must be completed within a mandatory maintenance window of six weeks or less. Respondents should identify relevant experience, available personnel and facilities, configuration coverage, and demonstrated ability to meet this schedule. 2.2 Embedded AC&R Technical Expertise at SIMAs The Government is considering embedded air conditioning and refrigeration (AC&R) expertise at designated Navy Shore Intermediate Maintenance Activities (SIMAs) to support Sailor training and Navy-led Minor Pit Stops. Support may include hands-on instruction, troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and technical oversight. Minor Pit Stops must also be completed within a mandatory maintenance window of six weeks or less. 2.3 AC Plant Materiel Support This capability includes identifying, sourcing, procuring, managing, and delivering configuration-specific repair parts, components, assemblies, and overhaul materiel for planned maintenance, emergent repairs, casualty response, and restoration of AC plant capability. 2.4 Global Warehouse and Rotable Pool Management This capability includes establishing and managing rotable inventories and Overhaul Parts Packages (OPPs), including storage, configuration control, issue and return, repair or overhaul, replenishment, transportation, and positioning inventory to support geographically dispersed maintenance activities. 2.5 Engineering, Technical Data, Logistics, and Integrated Product Support This capability may include configuration-specific engineering and technical assistance, technical data and documentation, maintenance procedures, failure and root-cause analysis, technical dispositions, reliability and maintainability support, obsolescence management, and other Integrated Product Support. 2.6 Global Unplanned and Emergent Field Services This capability includes responsive technical troubleshooting, on-site assessment, engineering assistance, repair recommendations, identification and sourcing of required materiel, and other field services needed to restore AC plant capability at Navy locations worldwide. Respondents should describe geographic coverage, response capability, and the ability to support emergent work while meeting scheduled maintenance commitments. 3.0 CAPABILITY CERTIFICATION MATRIX AND SUPPORTING EVIDENCE Respondents should complete Table 1 for each capability area addressed. For each area, select YES, PARTIAL, or NO and identify the proposed method of performance: organic capability, existing OEM or license arrangement, subcontractor or teaming partner, or capability to be developed. A response of YES should reflect current capability. PARTIAL should identify the elements currently available and any gaps. NO indicates that the respondent does not currently possess the capability. Respondents may identify capabilities available through subcontractors, teaming partners, suppliers, license agreements, or other third-party arrangements. Clearly identify the organization responsible for each capability and whether the relationship is established or would need to be formed. Distinguish current capabilities from those that would require additional agreements, licensing, qualification, investment, or development. Provide concise, specific, and verifiable supporting information for each YES or PARTIAL response, as applicable. Useful evidence may include: Relevant contracts or programs, customers, periods of performance, and scope of work; AC plant configurations or comparable equipment supported and geographic locations served; Personnel, facilities, tooling, diagnostic or test equipment, inventory, and logistics infrastructure; Demonstrated maintenance capacity, schedule performance, response times, and relevant past performance; and Access to technical data, licenses, specialized resources, or other arrangements necessary to perform the work, including any material limitations. Respondents are not expected to provide a detailed technical proposal or develop a new solution in response to this notice. Concise evidence sufficient to describe the respondent�s capabilities and approach is encouraged. 4.0 ALTERNATIVE APPROACHES AND CAPABILITY GAPS Respondents may identify alternative approaches that could meet the Government�s underlying sustainment needs or improve maintenance execution, materiel availability, technical support, reliability, maintainability, or operational availability. Briefly describe the approach, the requirements it addresses, any differences from the contemplated approach, and any Government resources, approvals, or changes that would be necessary. The Government makes no commitment to adopting a proposed alternative. Respondents should identify any capability gaps, dependencies, or limitations that could affect performance, including the anticipated time and conditions needed to establish a capability. The Government may use this information to assess individual capabilities, combinations of capabilities, teaming approaches, and the feasibility of different acquisition structures. 5.0 RESPONSE FORMAT Responses should not exceed ten pages, excluding Table 1 and relevant supporting documentation. Respondents need only address the capability areas relevant to their organization and proposed approach. Please include: Company name and address, UEI, CAGE code, and business size/status; Primary point of contact, including email and telephone number; Completed Capability Certification Matrix (Table 1); A concise description of the capability areas addressed and the proposed method of performance; Specific supporting evidence for each YES or PARTIAL response, including relevant past performance where available; and Identification of any relevant teaming, subcontracting, licensing, technical-data access, or other third-party arrangements and their status. description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), Program Manager Air (PMA)-275, intends to award a sole-source Delivery Order to Honeywell International Inc. under Basic Ordering Agreement N0001923G0004 for the procurement of Environmental Control System (ECS) components in support of V-22 Block B to Block C Mission Computer Obsolescence Initiative (MCOI) upgrades. These components consist of: ECS Controller, National Stock Number (NSN) 4120-01-583-4350; Environmental Control Unit, NSN 1680-01-583-4344; Cockpit Flow Control Valve, NSN 1680-01-584-2936; Nosebay Avionics Cooling Supply Fan Motor, NSN 1680-01-482-7098; and Nosebay Fan Bracket, NSN 5340-01-545-5814. The required ECS components are necessary to support the integration, sustainment, and fielding of the Block B to Block C MCOI upgrade effort for the V-22 fleet. The estimated period of performance is two years, with anticipated award in September 2027. This action is being awarded on a sole-source basis to Honeywell International Inc. in accordance with the statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition under Title 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.103-1, �Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements.� Honeywell International Inc. is the original equipment manufacturer and current source with the requisite proprietary technical data, configuration knowledge, manufacturing capability, and supply-chain access necessary to provide components compatible with the existing V-22 ECS configuration. Award to another source would require the Government to obtain or develop technical data, conduct engineering analysis and qualification activities, establish manufacturing capability, and complete integration and airworthiness-related assessments. These actions would introduce unacceptable schedule, cost, configuration-control, and fleet-readiness risk to the V-22 Block B-to-C MCOI upgrade effort. Honeywell International, Inc. is the only source that has the knowledge, experience, technical expertise, and source data to provide these parts to meet the Government�s need. This notice is not a request for competitive proposals. However, responsible sources that believe they can satisfy the requirement may submit capability information demonstrating their ability to provide ECS components fully compatible with the V-22 configuration and required delivery schedule. Submitted information must address access to applicable technical data; manufacturing, quality-assurance, and configuration-management capability; and the ability to meet required delivery and support requirements.

title: CO NP ROMO 407(1) Holzwarth Culvert
description: SOLICITATION ID: 6982AF27B000004 PROJECT NUMBER: CO FTNP ROMO 407(1) PROJECT NAME: Holzwarth Culvert PROJECT DESCRIPTION: This project will replace the deficient Holzwarth Culvert (Structure No. 1520-029S), a six-barrel corrugated metal arch pipe culvert on the Holzwarth Access Road with a steel girder bridge. Located in Rocky Mountain National Park, approximately nine miles north of Grand Lake, CO, along US HWY 34 at an elevation of 8,900 feet, the culvert conveys flow from the Colorado River and provides access to the Holzwarth Historic Site. The purpose of this project is to prevent future roadway damage and flooding while maintaining access to employee housing, the historic site, and National Park Service and Forest Service recreation opportunities. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The project will consist of removal of the existing six barrel culvert and construction of a new steel girder bridge with a cast in place concrete deck. New bridge abutments and micropiles. Temporary stream diversion and riprap. New aggregate roadway surfacing. Relocation of an existing electrical line. Relocation of existing historic head gates into a new concrete slab. The site is accessible on foot a quarter mile past the locked gate at the south end of the Holzwarth Historic Site Parking Lot and along the Holzwarth Culvert Access Road. The Holzwarth Culvert Access Road is approximately 13� wide with tight turns. Temporary widening will be necessary to prevent truck off tracking on to sensitive environmental resources. A temporary truck turnaround will also be necessary as no construction access is allowed more than 100� west of the bridge. PRINCIPAL WORK ITEMS: 20304-2000 Removal of Bridge: 1 EACH 30202-2000 Roadway Aggregate, Method 2: 120 TON 55504-0000 Prefabricated Steel Bridge (10� wide x 48� long modular steel vehicular bridge): 1 LPSM 56701-0000 Micropile (8.68� dia.): 180 LNFT 62801-0000 Temporary Stream Diversion: 1 LPSM ANTICIPATED SCHEDULE: Advertisement � September 2026 Award � December 2026 NTP � December 2026 Contract Completion � November 2027 ESTIMATED COST RANGE: Total estimated cost between $700,000 and $2,000,000.

title: Robotic Sheet Metal Forming CAPABILITY REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
description: This is a Capability Request for Information (CRFI) issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) and does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with responding to this notice. The United States Air Force Rapid Sustainment Office (RSO) is conducting market research analysis to identify existing solutions for an on-demand, dieless robotic sheet metal forming capability. This capability is intended to produce structural components, brackets, panels, skin sections, and spare parts for support equipment, and aircraft at depot, maintenance, or factory-level facilities. Traditional manufacturing of sheet metal parts relies on heavy, expensive tooling, dies, and presses that require long lead times, high upfront costs, and physical storage. Robotic sheet metal forming�utilizing dual-sided or single-sided synchronized robotic arm manipulators equipped with generic, interchangeable forming styli�offers a flexible, software-defined alternative. The objective of this research is to identify commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) or rapidly adaptable solutions capable of being integrated into standard industrial manufacturing and maintenance facilities. This capability is aimed at reducing reliance on traditional supply chains, eliminating the need for part-specific hard tooling, and dramatically accelerating low-volume manufacturing and prototyping cycles. Submitters are encouraged to highlight existing commercial technologies and details on how their hardware and software solutions can be integrated into industrial DoW facilities. Submitters may also identify optional services, such as operator training, technical support, tooling/stylus consumables, and system maintenance. See the attachment with this notice for additional details.

Attachment 7 and Attachment 8 are revised accordingly. Additionally, this amendment corrects various administrative errors and inconsistencies throughout the solicitation. To view the amendment and revised documents access the PIEE Solicitation Module Link for W912BU26RA032 below*** The US Army Corps of Engineers, Philadelphia District (NAP) has issued a Request for Proposal (RFP) for one firm-fixed-price Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) contract to provide power construction and services in contingency or austere environments in support of temporary or enduring requirements of the United States Government (USG); USG Coalition Forces/Organizations; and Host-Nation Governments/Forces/Organizations within the United States Central Command Area of Responsibility (CENTCOM AOR) and select United States European Command (EUCOM) countries to include Ukraine, Poland, Romania, Bulgaria, Kosovo, Bosnia, Norway, Turkey, Slovakia, and Greenland. A target of three (3) to seven (7) contracts will be awarded to a pool of contractors that will subsequently compete for individual task orders. This Power Construction and Services II Multiple-Award Task Order Contract (PCS II MATOC) will have total shared contract capacity of $249,000,000.00. A virtual industry day will be hosted by the USACE Philadelphia District on 17 September 2026 at 1000 hrs ET. description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE / MARKET RESEARCH Leased Mobile Computed Tomography (CT) Unit Hopi Health Care Center (HHCC) Indian Health Service (IHS) Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE) Sources Sought THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION, REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ), OR REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP). NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED AS A RESULT OF THIS NOTICE. 1. PURPOSE The Indian Health Service (IHS) is conducting market research to identify qualified Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs) capable of providing a temporary, fully operational Mobile Computed Tomography (CT) unit for the Hopi Health Care Center (HHCC). This Sources Sought Notice is being conducted under the authority of the Buy Indian Act, 25 U.S.C. � 47, and applicable requirements of HHSAR Subpart 326.71 (RFO Deviation) to determine the availability and capability of ISBEE concerns to satisfy this requirement. The information obtained through this notice will assist IHS in determining the appropriate acquisition strategy and developing the final requirement. Interested respondents representing themselves as an Indian Economic Enterprise (IEE) or Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE) shall submit a completed Indian Economic Enterprise Representation in accordance with HHSAR 352.226-76, Indian Economic Enterprise Representation (OCT 2026) (RFO DEVIATION), with their response to this Sources Sought Notice. 2. BACKGROUND The Indian Health Service (IHS), Hopi Health Care Center (HHCC), has an immediate need for temporary Mobile Computed Tomography (CT) capability to support continuity of patient care while the Government pursues a longer-term solution. The anticipated duration of the Mobile CT requirement is approximately twelve (12) months. 3. ANTICIPATED REQUIREMENT IHS anticipates requiring the Contractor to furnish for lease a fully operational Mobile CT unit at the Hopi Health Care Center. Minimum of 32 Slices. This is an equipment requirement and is not for CT technologist staffing. The Government intends to provide qualified personnel to operate the CT equipment. The Contractor is anticipated to be responsible for, at a minimum: � Mobile CT unit and associated equipment necessary for operation; � Delivery and mobilization to HHCC; � Installation, setup, and calibration of the equipment; � Coordination of required connectivity and interfaces with Government systems, as applicable; � Preventive and corrective maintenance; � Technical support and equipment repair throughout the period of performance; � All required equipment licenses and manufacturer support necessary for operation; � Training of Government personnel on the operation and use of the furnished CT equipment; and � Demobilization and removal of the Mobile CT unit at completion of the requirement. The Government has not finalized all technical specifications and is seeking information regarding commercially available Mobile CT solutions capable of satisfying the requirement. 4. DELIVERY / MOBILIZATION Due to the urgent need for CT capability, IHS is evaluating the commercial market's ability to mobilize a Mobile CT unit rapidly after contract award. Respondents shall identify the earliest timeframe in which they can deliver, install, test, and make a fully operational Mobile CT unit available at HHCC following contract award. Please specifically indicate whether your company can achieve operational readiness within: ?15 calendar days after award ? 30 calendar days after award ? 45 calendar days after award ? Other: ______ calendar days after award Respondents should briefly identify any conditions, site preparation, Government actions, utility requirements, or other factors that would affect the proposed mobilization timeframe. 5. GOVERNMENT-PROVIDED STAFF The Government anticipates providing qualified CT technologists and other clinical personnel necessary to operate the equipment. Respondents should identify any manufacturer-specific qualifications, certifications, or training required for Government personnel to operate the proposed CT system. The Contractor shall provide initial equipment training necessary for designated Government personnel to safely and effectively operate the furnished CT system. Respondents should describe the training normally provided with their commercial Mobile CT services, including anticipated duration and whether training can be conducted onsite. 6. CAPABILITY RESPONSE Interested ISBEE concerns should provide a concise capability response addressing the following: Company name, address, point of contact, telephone number, and email address. Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and CAGE Code. Confirmation that the company is currently a qualified Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE). Description of the Mobile CT unit(s) available to support this requirement, including: Manufacturer; Model; Number of slices/configuration; Approximate age/year of manufacture; Relevant technical specifications; Mobile trailer/unit configuration; and Any other capabilities the respondent considers relevant. Earliest achievable delivery and operational-readiness timeframe following award (15, 30, 45 days, or other). Description of site and utility requirements necessary to operate the proposed Mobile CT unit, including electrical requirements, physical footprint, pad requirements, HVAC or environmental requirements, and network/connectivity requirements. Description of the Contractor's approach to: Mobilization and setup; Equipment testing and calibration; Preventive maintenance; Corrective/emergency maintenance; Equipment downtime; Technical support; and Demobilization. Description of the training that would be provided to Government CT technologists and other designated personnel. Description of PACS/DICOM and other connectivity capabilities associated with the proposed equipment. Examples of recent experience providing Mobile CT equipment or comparable diagnostic imaging equipment to Federal, Tribal, State, local, or commercial healthcare facilities. Whether the company would perform the requirement directly or utilize subcontractors. If subcontractors are anticipated, identify the anticipated division of responsibilities. For market research purposes only, provide an estimated commercial monthly rate or price range for a twelve-month Mobile CT deployment. Please identify whether the estimated rate includes: Mobilization; Demobilization; Equipment rental/use; Maintenance and repairs; Technical support; Training; and Other applicable costs. Pricing information submitted in response to this Sources Sought is for market research and acquisition-planning purposes only and will not constitute a quotation or offer. 7. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE Hopi Health Care Center Polacca, Arizona 86042 The Government will provide additional site-specific information as the requirement is developed. 8. ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE Approximately twelve (12) months lease. The final period of performance will be established in any resulting solicitation. 9. RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS Interested ISBEE concerns should submit capability information electronically to: Dekovan Cook Contract Specialist Indian Health Service � Phoenix Area Email: dekovan.cook@ihs.gov Phone: (602) 364-5018 Response Due Date: October 27, 2026 at 5pm EST Responses should be concise and contain sufficient information for the Government to determine the respondent's capability and availability. 10. title: Z2DA--Construct Inpatient Tower 7th Floor, Cincinnati, OH
description: SYNOPSIS: INTRODUCTION: This Sources Sought Notice is for market research and information purposes only at this time and shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) is conducting a market survey and is seeking potential sources for Project 539-336: Construct Inpatient Tower 7th Floor at the Cincinnati VA Medical Center located in Cincinnati, Ohio. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: This project will construct a 6000sf addition on top of the 6th floor. This space will be used for inpatient mental health programs and clinics. It also includes the renovation of 9500sf of existing mental health space on the 7th floor for a total construction project of 15,500sf. This project will significantly increase patient privacy, enhance security and increase efficiency to the Veteran. The work includes hazardous materials abatement, uninterrupted critical service lines (power, gas, etc.), infection control, use of cranes and fall protection, phased construction plans, and significant work in the following divisions: structural, architectural, fire protection, plumbing, mechanical, electrical, and telecom. PROCUREMENT INFORMATION: The proposed project will be a competitive, firm-fixed-price contract utilizing the design-bid-build approach (Final Specifications and Drawings will be provided). The anticipated solicitation will be issued either as a Request For Proposal (RFP) in accordance with FAR Part 15, considering Technical and Price Factors or as an Invitation for Bid (IFB) in accordance with FAR Part 14, considering Price only. The results and analysis of the market research will finalize the determination of the procurement method. The type of socio-economic set-aside, if any, will depend upon the responses to this notice and any other information gathered during the market research process. This project is planned for advertising in December 2026. In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $10,000,000.00 and $20,000,000.00. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 236220 (size standard $45.0 million) applies to this procurement. The duration of the project is currently estimated at 730 calendar days from the issuance of a Notice to Proceed. The services for this project will include providing all construction related services such as: providing labor, materials and equipment required to complete the project as per contract documents prepared by an independent Architect-Engineer firm. CAPABILITY STATEMENT: Respondents shall provide a general capabilities statement to include the following information: Section 1: Provide company name, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), company address, Point-of-Contact name, phone number and email. Section 2: Provide company business size based on NAICS code 236220. Also, provide business type (i.e., Large Business, Small Business, Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Business, Women-Owned Small Business, Hub Zone Small Business, etc.). Section 3: Provide a Statement of Interest in the project. Section 4: Provide the prime contractor s available bonding capacity in the form of a letter of intent from your bonding company with this submission. *Please ensure that the individual bonding capacity is in line with the VAAR Magnitude of Construction listed above. Section 5: Provide the type of work your company has performed in the past in support of the same or similar requirement. This section is IMPORTANT as it will help to determine the type of socio-economic set-aside, if any. Please provide the following in your response: No more than three (3) contracts that your company has performed within the last seven (7) years that are of comparable size, complexity, and scope to this requirement. Include the project name, project owner and contact information as this person may be contacted for further information, project scope, project size (Example: square footage), building use (Example: Medical Facility, Office Building, etc.), project dollar value, start and completion dates. Provide specific examples that relate aspects of previous projects to the proposed project. Describe specific technical skills and key personnel your company possess to perform the requirements described under description of work. Describe your Self-Performed** effort (as either a Prime or Subcontractor). Describe Self-Performed work in terms of dollar value and description. **Self-Performed means work performed by the offeror themselves, NOT work performed by another company for them for any of the project examples provided. It is requested that interested contractors submit a response (electronic submission) of no more than eight (8) single sided pages, single-spaced, 12-point font minimum that addresses the above information. This response must be submitted as a single application-generated (not scanned) PDF document that is less than or equal to 4MB in size. Please note that hard copies will not be accepted. Please also include a cover page, which includes, at a minimum: the company s name, address, Unique Entity Identifier (if available), socio-economic status, point-of-contact name, phone number, and e-mail address. Responses must include the Sources Sought number and project title in the subject line of their e-mail response. Submissions (responses) shall be submitted via email to the primary and secondary points of contact listed below by October 27, 2026, at 5:00 PM ET. No phone calls will be accepted. The Capabilities Statement submitted in response to this Sources Sought shall not be considered to be a bid or proposal. This notice is for information and planning purposes only and is neither to be construed as a commitment by the Government nor will the Government pay for information solicited. No evaluation letters and/or results will be issued to the respondents. After completing its analyses, the Government will determine whether to limit competition among the small business categories listed above or proceed with full and open competition as other than small business. At this time no solicitation exists; therefore, please do not request a copy of the solicitation. If a solicitation is released it will be synopsized in Contract Opportunities at https://sam.gov/. It is the potential offeror's responsibility to monitor this site for the release of any solicitation or synopsis. title: Aircraft Pressurized Cabin Leakage Tester (APCLT)
description: SYNOPSIS: #N68335-26-Q-1204 Aircraft Pressurized Cabin Leakage Tester (APCLT) Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division - F/A-18F and EA-18G Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) Program The Naval Air Warfare Center, Aircraft Division (NAWCAD) Lakehurst, NJ intends to negotiate on a sole source basis with Hydraulics International, Inc. (CAGE: 56529) for the Aircraft Pressurized Cabin Leakage Tester (APCLT) in support of the NAWCAD F/A-18F and EA-18G Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) Program. This order will procure one (1) APCLT (Part Number (P/N): 4129AS0100-1, National Stock Number (NSN): 4920-01-658-2036). The APCLT is required to check aircraft pressurized cabins and canopy seals for leaks and for the ability to control aircraft cabin pressure. The pneumatic cabin pressure leakage tester will provide the means to meet the requirement and is required by the RAAF. The pneumatic cabin pressure leakage tester is a portable unit that runs on facility supplied compressed air and that can supply various combinations of air flow and air pressure to check leakage and pressure regulation in aircraft cabins and canopy seals. Hydraulics International, Inc., as the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the APCLT, is the only source with the requisite knowledge, technical experience, and production-level data to produce these components. The components being procured are integral to check aircraft pressurized cabins and canopy seals for leaks and for the ability to control aircraft cabin pressure and are critical to maintaining operational readiness. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate this requirement under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 2304(c)(1), FAR 6.302-1 - Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. However, the Government will consider all responses received within fifteen days after the date of publication of this synopsis. Registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) (https://www.sam.gov) is mandatory for consideration. A determination by the Government not to open the requirement to competition based on the responses to this notice will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. Information provided herein is subject to change and in no way binds the Government to solicit for an award of a contract. title: Romania – Other community, social and personal services – Servicii de training în comunicare, pe teme legate de finanțările europene, în cadrul proiectului „Rețeaua națională a comunicatorilor - asigurarea amplificării mesajelor pentru promovarea investițiilor europene”, Cod SMIS 338369/2.070
description: Acordul-cadru va asigura organizarea unor programe de formare în domeniul comunicării (training-uri în comunicare), destinate următoarelor categorii de participanți: • personalului de conducere din cadrul MIPE, respectiv demnitari, înalți funcționari publici, directori generali, directori și șefi de serviciu, având în vedere rolul acestora în reprezentarea instituției și în asigurarea imaginii acesteia (purtători de imagine), precum și faptul că funcția de comunicare reprezintă o componentă a procesului de management; • personalului din cadrul DGCCI (Direcția Generală Comunicare și Cooperare Internațională), având în vedere atribuțiile acestuia în domeniul comunicării instituționale și al informării publice - inclusiv în ceea ce privește comunicarea cu mass-media și diseminarea informațiilor către publicul țintă al programelor finanțate din FEN 2021–2027 gestionate de MIPE; • membrilor Rețelei Naționale a Comunicatorilor, cu condiția ca aceștia să nu fi participat anterior la programe de formare cu tematică similară, finanțate din alte fonduri publice europene sau naționale. Training-urile vor avea loc în regiunile de dezvoltare ale României, în perioada 2026-2029, vor fi în număr de 5, cu maxim 30 de participanți/training. Activitatea de organizare a sesiunilor de training include asigurarea componentei logistice pentru asigurarea experților formatori pentru sesiunile de training, a secretariatului tehnic, asigurarea cazării 6 nopți pentru maxim 30 de persoane (respectiv 25 de cursanți/ sesiune și 5 persoane responsabile de organizare din partea Autorității Contractante, mic dejun inclus), asigurarea serviciilor de catering pentru maxim 30 de persoane/ sesiune, închirierea sălii de conferințe pentru 5 zile/ sesiune, asigurarea personalului tehnic necesar pe durata desfășurării sesiunii de training, tipărirea și distribuirea suportului de curs, amenajarea locației evenimentului cu materiale de signalistică, realizarea materialelor de signalistică, asigurarea serviciilor de transport. Valoarea estimată: bugetul maxim estimat al acordului-cadru este de 1.180.291,67 RON fără TVA. Bugetul minim estimat al acordului-cadru este de 236.058,33 RON fără TVA. Valoarea estimată minimă a unui contract subsecvent: 236.058,33 RON fără TVA. Valoarea maximă estimată a celui mai mare contract subsecvent: 708.175 RON fără TVA. Autoritatea contractantă estimează încheierea a minim 1 contract subsecvent, maxim 5 contracte subsecvente. Tipul procedurii de achizitie: Procedura proprie Posibilitatea depunerii de oferte alternative: Nu pot fi depuse oferte alternative. Legislația aplicată • OMIPE nr. 555/24.03.2025 privind aprobarea normelor interne privind atribuirea contractelor de achiziție publică/acordurilor-cadru organizate prin procedura de atribuire aplicabilă în cazul serviciilor sociale şi al altor servicii specifice. • LEGEA NR. 98/2016 privind achizitiile publice, cu modificarile si completarile ulterioare; • HOTĂRÂREA GUVERNULUI nr. 395/2016 pentru aprobarea Normelor metodologice de aplicare a prevederilor referitoare la atribuirea contractului de achiziţie publică/acordului-cadru din Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achiziţiile publice, cu modificarile si completarile ulterioare; Oferta câștigătoare va fi cea care va obține punctajul total cel mai mare. Criteriul de atribuire aplicat de Autoritatea Contractantă pentru această procedură este „Cel mai bun raport calitate-preț” în conformitate cu art.187, alin.(3), lit. a) din Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achizițiile publice, cu modificările și completările ulterioare. Autoritatea contractantă va încheia acordul cadru cu operatorul economic, a cărui ofertă admisibilă a fost clasată pe primul loc în urma aplicării criteriului de atribuire - cel mai bun raport calitate/preț. În cazul în care 2 oferte sunt clasate pe primul loc, au punctaje egale, departajarea se va face având în vedere punctajul obținut la factorii de evaluare în ordinea descrescătoare a ponderilor acestora. În situația în care egalitatea se menține, autoritatea contractantă va solicita operatorilor economici respectivi, pentru departajare, transmiterea unei noi propuneri financiare, în vederea stabilirii clasamentului final. Se solicită operatorilor economici să-și păstreze valabilitatea ofertei 6 luni de la data limită de depunere a ofertelor. Durata acordului-cadru: 37 luni de la momentul semnării contractului de către ultima parte, dar nu mai tarziu de 30.11.2029. Garanția de participare : Nu este cazul. Garanția de bună execuție: Garanția de bună execuție: se solicită constituirea garanției de bună execuție în valoare de 5 % din valoarea contractului fără TVA. Perioada de valabilitate a garanţiei de bună execuție va fi egală cu durata contractului subsecvent. Data limită pentru depunerea ofertei: 17.11.2026 (minim 30 zile de la data transmiterii spre publicare), ora 23:59 la adresa de e-mail: cristinel.cerbu@mfe.gov.ro. Data limită pentru transmiterea solicitărilor de clarificări: cu 20 zile inainte de termenul de depunere, ora 23:59. Data la care autoritatea contractantă va răspunde consolidat la solicitările de clarificări: cu minim 10 zile inainte de termenul de depunere, ora 23:59. Toate informatiile privind participarea la prezenta procedura precum si setul de documente aferente se regasesc pe site-ul MIPE (https://mfe.gov.ro/invitatii-de-participare/) la sectiunea Interes Public/Achizitii publice/Invitatii de participare. title: Denmark – Management-related services – Kontrakt om drift af Banedanmarks svellefabrik
description: Banedanmark ønsker at indgå en kontrakt med en driftsleverandør, som kan forestå den daglige, løbende drift af Banedanmarks svellefabrik beliggende Vejlbyvej 1, 7000 Fredericia og således ved brug af svellefabrikkens produktionsapparat producere og levere betonsveller i form af strækningssveller og sporskiftesveller, herunder svelletyper til særlige sporkonstruktioner såsom skinneudtræk ved broer, i forspændt beton til brug for Banedanmarks varetagelse af opgaven som jernbaneinfrastrukturforvalter. Produktionen sker efter long line-metoden. Driftsleverandøren skal i forbindelse hermed blandt andet: - Forestå en rationel og økonomisk forsvarlig produktion og levering af betonsveller af typerne Strækningssveller og Sporskiftesveller i overensstemmelse med kontraktens vilkår, - Som minimum opfylde kravene i DS/EN ISO 9001:2015 eller en tilsvarende standard for kvalitetsledelsessystem, jf. bilag 5 - Forestå kvalitetssikring af svelleproduktionen, - Løbende samarbejde med Banedanmark om en tilrettelæggelse af driften af Svellefabrikken, herunder deltage i samarbejdsmøder, - For egen regning indkøbe de nødvendige råvarer og materialer, der indgår i produktionen, i det omfang disse ikke i henhold til kontrakten er bygherreleverancer, som Banedanmark leverer, - Stille den nødvendige tekniske og administrative ekspertise til rådighed for driften af Svellefabrikken, herunder rådgive Banedanmark om udvikling og tilpasning af produktionen, - Bistå Banedanmark i forbindelse med ændringer af Svellefabrikken, herunder omstilling af produktionsapparatet med henblik på produktion af andre svelletyper, - Medvirke til en hensigtsmæssig tilrettelæggelse og gennemførelse af afhentningen af sveller fra fabrikken, herunder forestå læsning af sveller i forbindelse med transport af færdigproducerede sveller fra Svellefabrikken. For information om den historiske produktion af sveller henvises til bilag 17 til kontrakten. Driftsleverandøren forventes at overtage ansvaret for driften af svellefabrikken den 1.1.2028. Perioden fra den 1.9.2027 og forventeligt frem til den 31.1.2028 betragtes som en etableringsperiode. I denne periode samarbejder parterne tæt om hurtigst muligt at få etableret grundlaget for en stabil og effektiv drift af Svellefabrikken i overensstemmelse med kontraktens vilkår. Der henvises i øvrigt til Bilag 6, tidsplan for etablering. Den daglige ledelse af Svellefabrikken skal forestås af en fabrikschef. Fabrikschefen skal være ansat hos Driftsleverandøren (Banedanmarks kontraktpart). Kommunikationen mellem den af Driftsleverandøren antagne fabrikschef og Banedanmark skal foregå på dansk. Kontrakten er ikke til hinder for, at Banedanmark kan indkøbe sveller af tredjemand. Banedanmark er berettiget til at videresælge sveller til tredjemand. Lovbekendtgørelse nr. 710 af 20.8.2002 om lønmodtageres retsstilling ved virksomhedsoverdragelse med senere ændringer (Virksomhedsoverdragelsesloven) finder anvendelse i forbindelse med Driftsleverandørens overtagelse af ansvaret for driften af Svellefabrikken. De nærmere oplysninger herom fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Ansøgere, som bliver prækvalificeret, vil have mulighed for at deltage i 2 fremvisninger af svellefabrikken. De konkrete datoer fremgår af tidsplanen i punkt 3 i udbudsbetingelserne.

description: Im Rahmen des Projekts „Weiterentwicklung Carsharing“ stellt die Landeshauptstadt Mainz 25 Stellplätze im öffentlichen Straßenraum für den Betrieb mit stationsbasiertem Carsharing zur Verfügung. Für die Nutzung der Stellplätze wird eine straßenrechtliche Sondernutzungserlaubnis für die Dauer von 6 Jahren erteilt. Die Stellplätze werden im Rahmen eines einheitlichen Auswahlverfahrens an einen Carsharing-Anbieter vergeben. Der Carsharing-Anbieter ist verpflichtet, auf allen 25 Stellplätzen dauerhaft ein Carsharing-Angebot während der gesamten Laufzeit der straßenrechtlichen Sondernutzungserlaubnis zu betreiben. Dabei agiert der Carsharing-Anbieter wirtschaftlich selbstständig. Er trägt das wirtschaftliche Risiko der Unternehmung und leistet die Administration und Disposition. Er trägt die Verantwortung für ein wirksames Marketing des Carsharing-Angebotes. Die Abrechnung des Carsharing-Angebots hat exakt, anhand der tatsächlichen gebuchten Zeitintervalle und der gefahrenen Kilometer, zu erfolgen. Das Carsharing hat ausschließlich stationsbasiert zu erfolgen - es ist kein free-floating oder stationsflexibler Betrieb zulässig.

description: Rahmenvereinbarung Kanalreinigung- und Inspektion für Einrichtungen der Bundesrepublik Deutschland in Schleswig-Holstein. _________________________________________________________________________________________________ Im Zuge von Bestandsaufnahmen zur Erstellung von LAKs (Liegenschaftsbezogenen Abwasserentsorgungskonzepten), Gewährleistungsabnahmen von Kanalsanierungsmaßnahmen, Kanalinspektionen vor Kanalsanierungsmaßnahmen, sowie Abnahmeinspektionen von Kanalsanierungsmaßnahmen sollen Schmutz- und / oder Regenwasserkanalisationen von Liegenschaften des Bundes vollständig und/oder teilweise gereinigt und auf Schäden untersucht werden. Die entsprechenden Liegenschaften können der beigefügten Liste entnommen werden. Es handelt sich um Liegenschaften mit weniger als 100 m Kanallänge bis zu mehreren Kilometern Kanalnetz. _________________________________________________________________________________________________ Hinweis: Beschränkung der Zahl der Lose, für die ein Bieter den Zuschlag erhalten kann. Die Abgabe eines Angebotes für mehrere Lose ist zulässig. Es wird allerdings pro Auftragnehmer maximal 1 Los beauftragt, da der Umfang der Arbeiten sehr umfangreich ist. Jeder Bieter kann Wünsche in Form einer Liste äußern, welches Los er vordringlich gewinnen möchte, sollte er der Bestbietende in mehreren Losen sein. Er erhält dann das Los, das in seiner persönlichen Liste auf Rang 1 ist. Fehlt diese Liste steht es der Vergabestelle frei das zu gewinnende Los festzusetzen. D. h. Im ersten Schritt wird geprüft, welcher Bieter welches Los gewinnt. Sollte jeder Bieter jeweils nur ein Los gewinnen, kommt das Verfahren nicht zur Anwendung. Wenn ein Bieter 2 Lose gewinnt erhält er den Zuschlag auf das Los, dass in seiner Wunschliste den höheren Platz hat. Der Gewinn des anderen Loses entfällt dann und es gewinnt das Los derjenige, der in dem Los auf Rang 2 ist. Sollte bei diesem Verfahren ein unwirtschaftliches Angebot den Zuschlag erhalten sollen, dann behält sich die Vergabestelle vor, die unwirtschaftlichen Lose aufzuheben und in einem Verhandlungsverfahren ohne Teilnahmewettbewerb neu auszuschreiben. _________________________________________________________________________________________________ Die Ausschreibung wird in folgende regionale Lose aufgeteilt: Los 1: Flensburg Glücksburg Los 2: Nordfriesland Schleswig-Flensburg Los 3: Rendsburg-Eckernförde Los 4: Pinneberg Steinburg Dithmarschen Los 5: Kiel Neumünster Lübeck _________________________________________________________________________________________________ Für diese Rahmenvereinbarung gelten die folgenden Höchstwerte für die zu erbringenden Leistungen im ausgeschriebenen Zeitraum: Los 1: 710.000,00 € netto. Los 2: 1.480.000,00 € netto. Los 3: 930.000,00 € netto. Los 4: 820.000,00 € netto. Los 5: 1.540.000,00 € netto. Mit Erreichen dieser Höchstwerte endet die Rahmenvereinbarung automatisch, unabhängig von der ursprünglich vereinbarten Laufzeit.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Machbarkeitsstudie Generalsanierung
description: Erstellung einer interdisziplinären Machbarkeitsstudie für die Generalsanierung der Bayerischen Staatsoper Nationaltheater Das Nationaltheater ist der Spielort der Bayerischen Staatsoper, des Bayerischen Staatsorchesters und des Bayerischen Staatsballetts. In seiner jetzigen neoklassizistischen Erscheinung wurde das Opernhaus im Jahr 1818 erstmals eröffnet. Fünf Jahre später wurde das Haus durch einen Brand zur Gänze zerstört und erneut aufgebaut. Der zweite Wiederaufbau nach der Zerstörung im Zweiten Weltkrieg bis auf die Außenmauern fand in den Jahren 1958 – 1963 statt. Seit der Wiedereröffnung im Jahr 1963 wurde keine Generalsanierung durchgeführt. Zum Gebäudekomplex gehört auch das Dekorationsmagazin entlang der Alfons-Goppel-Straße und das im Jahr 2003 fertiggestellte sog. „Neue Probengebäude“ am Marstallplatz. Weitere für den Probe- und Spielbetrieb genutzte Gebäude sind die Gebäude des Bayerischen Staatsballetts, Platzl 6 und 7, hierbei handelt es sich um ehemalige Corpsgebäude, die 1899 im Stil der Renaissance errichtet wurden. Mit zeitlichem Vorlauf und parallel zur Machbarkeitsstudie wird von Nutzerseite die Erstellung eines Bedarfsgesamtkonzepts einschließlich Visionsentwicklung („Oper der Zukunft“) beauftragt. Gleichzeitig wird außerdem die Bedarfsplanung für eine Interimslösung während der Generalsanierung des Nationaltheaters erstellt. Die Machbarkeitsuntersuchung soll in einem iterativen Prozess mit dem Nutzer und der Bedarfsplanung fortwährend abgeglichen werden. Die Beiträge und Ergebnisse aus der Machbarkeitsstudie sollen sodann in die Bedarfsplanung integriert werden und umgekehrt. Die Studie sollte sich mit den baulich- technischen Sanierungsnotwendigkeiten, funktionalen Optimierungen der betrieblichen Abläufe, möglichen Erweiterungsoptionen, den wesentlichen Belangen des Denkmalschutzes und, nicht zuletzt, den Möglichkeiten energetischer Optimierung der haustechnischen Anlagen auseinandersetzen. Bei der Erstellung der Machbarkeitsstudie sind insbesondere die Ziele des nachhaltigen Bauens zu verfolgen. Ein ganzheitlicher Ansatz ist vorzusehen um den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Gebäude unter Berücksichtigung der ökologischen, ökonomischen und soziokulturellen Qualität sowie der technischen und prozessualen Aspekte zu betrachten. Der Auftragsgegenstand beinhaltet die Erstellung einer Machbarkeitsstudie für die oben genannten Nutzungen in drei Varianten als Entscheidungsgrundlage für die in der Zukunft geplante Generalsanierung. Weitere Angaben sind der Aufgabenbeschreibung und den Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Generalplanungsleistungen für die Sanierung und Instandsetzung der Tiefgarage Hospitalstraße 6, 55232 Alzey
description: Die Stadt Alzey beabsichtigt die Vergabe von Generalplanungsleistungen für die Instandsetzung einer schadensbedingt sanierungsbedürftigen Tiefgarage in der Hospitalstraße 6, 55232 Alzey. Gegenstand der Maßnahme ist die Planung, Koordinierung, Ausschreibung, Vergabeunterstützung und objektüberwachende Begleitung der erforderlichen baulichen und technischen Sanierung sowie Instandsetzungsmaßnahmen. Grundlage der Planung sind die Ergebnisse des vorliegenden Untersuchungsberichts sowie die dort festgestellten Schadensbilder und Handlungsempfehlungen. Die Tiefgarage weist nach vorliegenden Untersuchungen erhebliche Schäden an den tragenden Stahlbetonbauteilen, an Bodenflächen, Rampen, Treppenhausanschlüssen sowie an technischen Einbauten auf. Als wesentliche Schadensursachen wurden chlorid- und carbonatisierungsinduzierte Bewehrungskorrosion, Undichtigkeiten, Rissbildungen, Hohllagen und Schäden an Oberflächen und Beschichtungen festgestellt; der Instandsetzungsbedarf ist kurzfristig gegeben. Ziel der zu vergebenen Leistung ist die Erarbeitung eines fachlich belastbaren, wirtschaftlichen und dauerhaft tragfähigen Instandsetzungskonzepts sowie die vollständige Planung und Begleitung der Umsetzung bis zur mängelfreien Fertigstellung. Die Instandsetzung ist so zu planen, dass die Tiefgarage nach Abschluss der Maßnahme wieder den Anforderungen an Standsicherheit, Dauerhaftigkeit, Verkehrssicherheit und Gebrauchstauglichkeit entspricht und eine weitere planmäßige Nutzungsdauer von 40 Jahren ermöglicht. Die Tiefgarage befindet sich im Nordwesten der Stadt Alzey und wird über die Hospitalstraße 6 erschlossen. Sie wurde im Jahr 1980 errichtet. Die Anlage besteht aus einem Bauteil, das nachträglich teilweise mit einem dreigeschossigen Wohn- und Geschäftshaus sowie einer Steinhalle überbaut wurde. Die verbleibenden Flächen oberhalb der Tiefgarage werden als zusätzliche Parkflächen genutzt. Insgesamt stehen rund 176 PKW-Stellplätze zur Verfügung, die sich auf zwei Parkgeschosse verteilen und öffentlich zugänglich sind.

description: Übergeordnetes Ziel des Wettbewerbsverfahrens ist die Entwicklung eines attraktiven und zukunftsfähigen Bahnhofsumfelds als Visitenkarte der Stadt Plochingen. Als bedeutender Mobilitätsknoten kommt dem Bahnhofsumfeld eine zentrale Bedeutung für das Ankommen in der Stadt sowie für die Verknüpfung unterschiedlicher Mobilitätsformen zu. Durch ein qualitätsvolles freiraum- und verkehrsplanerisches Konzept soll das Bahnhofsareal seiner Funktion als multimodale Verkehrsdrehscheibe künftig in einem attraktiv gestalteten Umfeld gerecht werden. Mit der Neugestaltung des Bahnhofsumfelds sollen attraktive, barrierefreie und klimaangepasste öffentliche Räume mit sicheren und übersichtlichen Wegeverbindungen für alle Verkehrsteilnehmenden geschaffen werden. Dabei sind die unterschiedlichen Anforderungen der verschiedenen Mobilitätsformen auf engem Raum zu berücksichtigen. Ziel ist die Entwicklung einer leistungsfähigen und multimodalen Verkehrsdrehscheibe, die eine sichere, effiziente und intuitive Verknüpfung aller Verkehrsarten gewährleistet und zugleich neue Mobilitätsangebote integriert. Insgesamt sollen das Stadtbild verbessert und die Aufenthaltsqualität im öffentlichen Raum nachhaltig gestärkt werden, sodass das Bahnhofsumfeld künftig mehr ist als ein reiner Transitraum. Der Realisierungswettbewerb zielt auf eine Vielzahl von freiräumlichen und funktional ganzheitlich betrachteten Lösungsansätzen sowie auf die Vergabe eines Planungsauftrags für die Objektplanung Freianlagen und Verkehrsanlagen mind. title: Germany – Building construction work – Stadt Bochum: Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer Sonnenschule, Lange Malterse 18
description: Die Stadt Bochum (nachfolgend "Auftraggeber") steht als Schulträger vor der Herausforderung, dem stetig wachsenden Raumbedarf aufgrund der steigenden Schulanmeldungen im Bochumer Stadtgebiet zu entsprechen. In diesem Zusammenhang herrscht - neben dem Erfordernis an Sanierungs- und Erhaltungsmaßnahmen bereits bestehender Schulgebäude - ein erheblicher Bedarf an der Schaffung neuer Sport- und Lernräume. Dabei ist der Auftraggeber nach dem Schulgesetz verpflichtet, Schulentwicklungsplanung zu betreiben. Zur Erfüllung dieser ihr gesetzlich obliegenden Pflicht plant der Auftraggeber dem wachsenden Raumbedarf im Rahmen eines umfassenden Schulbau- und Schulmodernisierungsprogramm zu begegnen. Dieses beinhaltet erforderliche Neubau-, Umbau- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen für 27 schulische Einrichtungen. Das Programm umfasst dabei alle Schularten und bezieht sich auf Grund-, Förder- und weiterführende Schulen. Eingebettet in dieses Schulbauprogramm soll nun die Erweiterung und der Umbau der Sonnenschule, Lange Malterse 18, 44795 Bochum erfolgen. Die bauliche Erweiterung sowie der Umbau der Sonnenschule soll durch einen Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer erfolgen. Die Sonnenschule ist eine vierzügig geplante Grundschule im Bochumer Stadtteil Weitmar. Das Schulgelände umfasst ein bestehendes Schulgebäude (ca. 900 m² bebaute Fläche), eine Sporthalle (ca. 500 m²) sowie ausgedehnte Schulhof- und Grünflächen. Das Bestandsgebäude ist nicht barrierefrei erschlossen. Die vorhandene Schüleranzahl von 206 SuS (SJ 2023/24) wird bis zum Schuljahr 2030/31 auf prognostizierte 276 SuS anwachsen. Die bestehenden Unterrichts- und OGS-Flächen sind für diesen Bedarf nicht ausreichend. Der Erweiterungsbedarf ergibt sich sowohl im Unterrichtsbereich (+4 Unterrichtsräume) als auch im OGS-Bereich (+142 m²). Die geplante Maßnahme soll in drei Schritten realisiert werden: Schritt 1: Temporäre Containeranlage (Nutzung ab SJ 2025/26) / bereits erfolgt Schritt 2: Neubau Cluster (Nutzung ab SJ 2030/31) Der Neubau ist gemäß der beiliegenden Machbarkeitsstudie angedacht als zwei- bis dreigeschossiger Baukörper in L-förmiger Kubatur entlang der Straße Lange Malterse und am Eingang des Schulhofs. Ziel ist eine kompakte Bebauung, die den Schulhof möglichst wenig zerstückelt und den vorhandenen Baumbestand weitgehend erhält. Schritt 3: Umbau / Umnutzung Bestand (nach Fertigstellung Neubau) Die Umbaumaßnahmen im Bestand beinhalten im Wesentlichen die Umnutzung einzelner Räume im Untergeschoss, Erdgeschoss und im 1.Obergeschoss. Gleichzeitig ist die Herstellung der südlichen, befestigten und unbefestigten Schulhoffläche nach der Fertigstellung des Neubaus vorgesehen. Dies umfasst ca. 2.245 m² Fläche. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung ist die Planung und Errichtung der baulichen Erweiterung inklusive vorbereitender Arbeiten gemäß der Beschreibung der Schnittstellen der Ausführung in der funktionalen Leistungsbeschreibung. Die vollständige funktionale Leistungsbeschreibung wird mit Aufforderung zur Angebotsabgabe zur Verfügung gestellt. Aus dieser werden die planerischen Schnittstellen zwischen den verschiedenen Disziplinen, Gewerken und Fachbereichen zu entnehmen sein. Mit dieser EU-weiten Bekanntmachung wird der Teilnahmewettbewerb eingeleitet. Weitere Informationen sind den auf der Vergabeplattform zur Verfügung gestellten Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Health and social work services – 10032371 - Strengthening reproductive health and empowerment of young women
description: The project Strengthening Reproductive Health and Empowerment of Young Women (SRHEYW) is a module of German Development Cooperation in the health sector in Tanzania. It is commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH in cooperation with the Ministry of Health (MoH) and the Prime Minister"s Office - Regional Administration and Local Government (PMORALG). The project is implemented from July 2026 to June 2029 and focuses on Tanga Region. Despite progress in women"s rights and access to health services, many young people in Tanzania, particularly adolescent girls and young women, continue to face significant barriers to exercising their sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR). Persistent gender norms, unequal power relations, limited access to reliable information, high rates of adolescent pregnancy, unmet need for family planning, gender-based violence, and unequal access to services for young people with disabilities continue to undermine reproductive autonomy and health outcomes. The project aims to improve the reproductive autonomy and health of young women and newborns in selected areas of Tanzania. It focuses on strengthening maternal, neonatal, and reproductive health services; empowering young people with the knowledge and skills needed to make informed decisions regarding their sexual and reproductive health; improving the social and institutional environment that influences these decisions; and increasing access to SRHR services for people with disabilities. The intervention targets adolescent girls and young women while also engaging boys and young men, parents, teachers, religious and community leaders, health workers, civil society organisations, and government institutions. Particular attention is given to vulnerable groups, including young people living with disabilities and out-of-school youth. The project combines interventions at individual, community, institutional, and societal levels. Through youth clubs, community dialogue processes, social and behaviour change communication campaigns, and support to local civil society organisations, the project seeks to create an enabling environment in which young people can access information, utilise services, exercise their rights, and make informed choices about their future.

title: Germany – Construction work – Umbau, Sanierung und Erweiterung Grundschule Am Harrl, Ulmenallee 3, 31675 Bückeburg - Schlosserarbeiten ; MSH-Profile 1.OG bis EG - Phase 4
description: Das Schulgebäude ist ein ca. 1876 erbauter historischer Massivbau, unterkellert und 4- geschossig. Das Schulgebäude ist als Baudenkmal nach § 3 Abs. 2 NDSchG eingestuft. Das Hauptgebäude enthält die Unterrichts-, Gruppen- und Differenzierungsräume, die Verwaltung, Mehrzweckräume sowie Nebenräume. Im UG befindet sich neben Lager- und Technikräumen ein Werkraum sowie eine Lehrküche, diese Nutzungen sollen im Zuge des Umbaus ertüchtigt werden. In der Phase 1 wurde ein drittes Treppenhaus über alle Geschosse und ein Mensaneubau (mit Musikräumen im 2.OG) errichtet. In der Phase 2 wurde das 3.OG (ehemalige Hausmeisterwohnung und der nicht genutzte Dachboden) zu Schulräumen umgenutzt und eine Lüftungsanlage im Dachboden eingebaut. Die Sanierung der Sanitärkerne mit Erstellung von neuen Steigesträngen erfolgte ebenfalls in Phase 2. Die Sanitärkerne und das 2.OG (Phase 3) sind derzeit noch Baustellenbereich. Ursprünglich sollte das Schulgebäude im laufenden Betrieb in den nächsten Jahren abschnittsweise saniert, umgebaut und erweitert werden. Damit die restlichen Geschosse unabhängig vom Schulbetrieb fertiggestellt werden können, wird der komplette Schulbetrieb ausgelagert. Voraussichtlich kann nach den Herbstferien 2026 die restliche Sanierung starten. In diesem Bauabschnitt (Phase 4) soll das 1. OG/ EG und der Rest des Kellergeschosses in einem Zuge saniert werden. Hinweis: Bei allen Abbrucharbeiten sind Feuerlöscher in unmittelbarer Nähe bereitzuhalten.

description: Am Standort Köln Merheim beabsichtigt der Landschaftsverband Rheinland (LVR) einen Neubau für die Forensik II "nebenan" erstellen zu lassen und die bisherige forensische Nutzung in der weiter bestehenden LVR-Klinik (dort künftig dann andere Nutzung) ganz aufzugeben. Hintergrund ist, dass das derzeit genutzte Gebäude den aktuellen baulichen und funktionalen Anforderungen nicht mehr entspricht und dauerhaft überbelegt ist. Das derzeit forensisch genutzte Gebäude (Haus "O") der LVR-Klinik liegt entfernt vom geplanten Neubauprojekt und wird nicht in die Neubauplanung einbezogen. Das Vorhaben umfasst sowohl eine quantitative Erweiterung der Platzzahl und die Anpassung der Raumgrößen als auch eine qualitative und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung der forensischen Versorgung. Die Generalplanerleistung für das Vorhaben Forensik Köln-Merheim umfasst im Wesentlichen folgende Leistungsbilder: - Objektplanung Gebäude und Innenräume HOAI Teil 3 Abschnitt 1 - Fachplanung Freianlagen HOAI Teil 3 Abschnitt 2 - Fachplanung Ingenieurbauwerke HOAI Teil 3 Abschnitt 3 - Fachplanung Verkehrsanlagen HOAI Teil 4 Abschnitt 4 - Fachplanung Tragwerk HOAI Teil 4 Abschnitt 1 - Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung Anlagengruppen 1-8 HOAI Teil 5 Abschnitt 5 - Beratungsleistungen gemäß Anlage 1 zu § 3 Abs. 1 HOAI: Bauphysik (Schall- und Wärmeschutz, Raumakustik) und geotechnische Beratungsleistung - Fachplanung Brandschutz Auf Grundlage der Ergebnisse der Vorplanung wird der Auftraggeber die Umsetzbarkeit (Finanzierung/Genehmigungsfähigkeit) des Vorhabens abschließend prüfen. Der Auftragnehmer stellt während der gesamten Vertrags-laufzeit eine ausreichende Zahl funktionsfähiger Warmluftgeräte und hygienisch aufbereiteter Mehr-weg-Wärmetextilien im Mietsystem bereit. title: USDA Forest Service Cultural Resource Evaluation and Documentation
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1284LM27Q0001 is issued as a Request for Quotes. The Sand Creek Road Cultural Site Evaluation project is evaluation of 25 previously identified cultural sites along approximately 6 miles of road located in McKenzie County on the McKenzie Ranger District of the Dakota Prairie Grasslands. The USFS is requesting that 25 unevaluated sites within a 50 ft ROW of Sand Creek Road (McKenzie County Road 2) have evaluative testing. A list of these sites is provided in Table 1 of the Performance Work Statement. The testing will be done in two phases. The intent of this contract is phase one. Phase one is shovel testing to determine the presence or absence of buried cultural material. Phase two will be formal testing to determine if found cultural deposits represent intact cultural components will be done at a later time and is not part of this contract. Many of the cairn sites have lithic materials found at these locations. The presence of lithic materials suggests that there may be evidence of open camp activities. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 541620. The small business size standard is $19M. This acquisition is a total small business set-aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. Please see the attached documents for specific requirements and submittal instructions.
